items_all.title: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
items_all.summary: Starting November 29, OpenAI will use data from Daybreak Blue sessions to train its models, even when users have turned off training. After backlash, a follow-up email promised a separate opt-out. The move revives concerns from the dispute with mathematicians who suspected OpenAI used their unpublished research for training without consent. items_all.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight

items_all.title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
items_all.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. items_all.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. items_all.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
items_all.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. items_all.title: datasette-llm 0.1a9
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin. It now picks up the default model used by LLM , which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model: Previously you would also need to specify a model with -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra . Tags: datasette , llm , datasette-agent

items_all_raw.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. items_all_raw.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI raised only about $11 billion in its latest funding round, less than half of the $30 billion it was targeting.
